neighbours.label: A clause about a person's subjective feeling or inner experience (feel proud, the freedom he felt, helps me escape, admire her because), firing on the feeling verb or the reason connective, vs clauses about the same people and activities with no inner state
fire: Swimming in the lake makes me feel calm after a long week at work.
She felt a rush of joy when her son crossed the finish line.
Reading old letters helps him escape the loneliness of the empty house.
Kids love the playground because they feel brave on the tall slide.
I respect my teacher deeply because she never gave up on me.
After the storm, the villagers realized how much they needed each other.
He felt guilty when he forgot his mother's birthday again.
Painting gives her a sense of peace that nothing else can.
quiet: Swimming in the lake is allowed from June to September for residents.
She stood near the finish line as her son crossed it in fourth place.
Reading old letters, he sorted them by year into three boxes.
Kids use the playground most often in the late afternoon.
My teacher taught at the school for thirty years before retiring.
After the storm, the villagers repaired the roofs and cleared the roads.
He forgot his mother's birthday and called her the next morning.
Painting the fence took her two days and four cans of paint.

predictions: Feeling verbs and the 'because/when' of an emotional reason reach 0.3-1.2; the same people doing the same activities described externally stay under 0.1. Broad pole, so near misses may fire weakly.
notes: Card: broad (2.4%), peaks on ' realize', ' escape', ' when', ' because', ' felt', ' me', '觉得', '因为'. Probe: 'they feel proud when they win' 1.239, 'helps me escape' 0.601, 'freedom he felt' 0.557, 'admire ... because' 0.474, 'People realize' 0.336; pump/highway/farm/invoice 0.012-0.022.
